texts.preamble: M/S.S.S & Co vs The District Revenue Officer And on 6 June, 2024 Author: G.R.Swaminathan Bench: G.R.Swaminathan W.P(MD)No.11665 of Before The Madurai Bench Of Madras High Court Dated: 06.06.2024 Coram The Honourable Mr.Justice G.R.Swaminathan W.P(MD)No.11665 of 2024 and W.M.P(MD)No.10411 of 2024 M/s.S.S & Co., Represented by its Partner Ajmeer Khan, Door No.15, Sahib Hasrath Street, M.K.Garden, Town & Village, Chennai. ... Petitio Vs. 1.The District Revenue Officer and Additional District Magistrate, Virudhunagar District, Virudhunagar. 2.The Special Tahsildar (Matches and Fireworks Investigation), Sivakasi, Virudhunagar District. 3.The Village Administrative Officer, V.Muthulingapuram Village, Virudhunagar Taluk, Virudhunagar District. ... Respond https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis M/S.S.S & Co vs The District Revenue Officer And on 6 June, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/75463307/ 1 1/6 W.P(MD)No. Prayer: Writ petition is filed under Article 226 of the Constitutio India, to issue a Writ of Mandamus, directing the respondents to de and unlock the two store rooms in the petitioner's firecrackers Mag and provide open access to the petitioner's firecrackers Magazine s in S.No. 262/4,5,6, 264/3,4,5,6 V.Muthulingapuram Virudhunagar Taluk and District in reference to the petitioner's Li No. E/Hq/Tn/21/1718(E56659) in Form Le-3 and consequently permit the petitioner to peacefully run the business operation in the peti mentioned firecrackers Magazine. For Petitioner : Mr.N.Dhilipkumar For Respondents : Mr.N.GA.Natraj Government Advocate Order Heard both sides.
texts.arguments: 2.The second respondent herein sealed the petition mentioned premises on the ground that the petitioner was found to manufacture crackers in violation of the norms laid down by the Hon'ble Supreme Court of India. https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis 7.The learned counsel appearing for the petitioner would strongly plead that the manufacture of the crackers is not in contravention of the norms laid down by the Hon'ble Supreme Court of India.
texts.petitioner_arguments: 2.The second respondent herein sealed the petition mentioned premises on the ground that the petitioner was found to manufacture crackers in violation of the norms laid down by the Hon'ble Supreme Court of India. https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis 7.The learned counsel appearing for the petitioner would strongly plead that the manufacture of the crackers is not in contravention of the norms laid down by the Hon'ble Supreme Court of India.
